note: Scenario: no-return rings from the engine's round-trip O2 field on the primary native DTM (1.01 m cells, outlines smoothed to about 10 m). Each ring is the outer edge of the ground where walking out on the fastest path and back the same way fits the budget, scored as factor * (out + return_margin * back), the engine's turn-back rule. A ring marked clipped_by_model_edge runs into the edge of the terrain model there.
